metadata.agent_last_message:
Implemented the C++20 command-line tool in [output/main.cpp](/workspace/output/main.cpp) with its CMake project in [output/CMakeLists.txt](/workspace/output/CMakeLists.txt). A workspace-level CMake entry point lets a clean checkout use `cmake -B build && cmake --build build`.

The project compiled successfully with `cmake -B build-root && cmake --build build-root`.

This implementation is **not yet byte-for-byte equivalent to BibTeX 0.99c**. In particular, `width$` and some name, case-conversion, and error-handling behavior are approximations, so the requested identical PDF output is not guaranteed.

    def run_bibtex(

        timeout: int = 30,

        with_log: bool = False,

    ) -> tuple[str, dict[str, Any] | None]:

        bib_file.write_text(bib_text, encoding="utf-8")
        bst_file.write_text(style_text, encoding="utf-8")
    
        args: list[str] = [
            *command,
            "--bib",
            str(bib_file),
            "--style",
            str(bst_file),
            "--output",

        if aux_text is not None:

            cites_file.write_text(cites_text, encoding="utf-8")
            args += ["--cites", str(cites_file)]
